Package org.jwcarman.codec.spi

package org.jwcarman.codec.spi
The Codec SPI — the entire contract of codec-core: Codec encodes and decodes one type, CodecFactory produces codecs for any type, and TypeRef captures parameterized types so generics survive erasure. Backends implement CodecFactory; transforms are Codec<byte[]> composed through Codec.andThen.
  • Class
    Description
    Codec<T>
    Converts values of type T to and from byte[].
    CodecException
    The root of every failure a Codec reports from Codec.encode(T) or Codec.decode(byte[]).
    CodecFactory
    Produces Codec instances for arbitrary types, backed by a serialization library.
    InvalidPayloadException
    The payload handed to Codec.decode(byte[]) is malformed, corrupt, or forged: bad framing, truncation, an authentication-tag or checksum mismatch, text outside an encoding's alphabet, a corrupt compressed stream, a payload that would expand past a size cap, or one that decodes to a type this codec does not produce.
    InvalidValueException
    The value handed to Codec.encode(T) cannot be encoded: a type the backend has no serializer for, a cyclic object graph, a class the backend requires to be registered and is not.
    TransientCodecException
    Something the codec depends on failed, and the input is not at fault: a key-management service timed out or throttled, a JCE provider cannot supply a transform, a compressor failed on valid input, or a provider returned something that violates its contract.
    TypeRef<T>
    Super type token capturing a full generic type at compile time, surviving erasure.
    UnsupportedFormatException
    The payload handed to Codec.decode(byte[]) is well-formed, but names a format this reader cannot handle: a version or an algorithm identifier this instance was not built to understand — typically because a newer writer produced it.
